thresholds.profit_factor_months: > 1 in at least 75 % of OOS months
thresholds.consistency: at least 75 % of OOS months positive and positive without the best month
thresholds.timeframes: OOS > 0 on M15 as well as M5

criteria:
Phase 5.2 final classification (definition verdicts@1). Pre-declared on 14 Nov 2026 BEFORE any October / November
result of the full study existed. Pure, read-only functions over a study's stored results; nothing is re-run and no
strategy, configuration or stored analysis is changed.

Out-of-sample (OOS) months for a redesigned strategy: every walk-forward test month, each chosen on DEVELOPMENT months
only (strict: a hold-out month never influences any choice). The originals are measured on the same months.

Criteria (all in R after costs per trade; sizing-independent):
  expectancy      pooled OOS expectancy > 0 AND hold-out expectancy (development choice) > 0
  trade_count     at least 30 OOS trades - a minimum SCREEN, not proof of statistical reliability
  profit_factor   pooled OOS PF >= 1.1 AND PF > 1 in at least 3 of 4 OOS months
  drawdown        OOS recovery factor (sum R / max drawdown in R) >= 1
  consistency     at least 3 of 4 OOS months positive AND the OOS sum stays positive without the best month
  timeframes      OOS expectancy > 0 on M15 as well as M5 (M1 - October only - is reported; a divergence is flagged)
  execution       OOS expectancy still > 0 with spread + slippage doubled (tripled is reported)
Classes:
  overfit       development >= +0.05 R/trade on >= 30 trades but OOS <= 0
  rejected      OOS <= 0, or fewer than 30 OOS trades and not positive
  promising     every criterion passes
  inconclusive  positive, but at least one criterion fails (including too few trades)
